_readme: The per-box INPUTS the renderer takes as arguments (director rule 5): MEM_TOTAL, SYS_RESERVE, HELD_OUT, SWAP_TOTAL are NEVER config cells -- a box with no guard passes its own measured values. These are local-town's measured /proc/meminfo at DH.432; they are the numbers the ratios were chosen to reproduce. Identity tokens are NEVER here: the kit derives them (host_tokens).
